landingPages.title: Obsolete & Off-Spec Chemicals — Reuse Before Disposal | ChemSurplus
landingPages.metaDescription: Before paying to dispose of obsolete or off-spec chemicals, find a legitimate reuse. The EPA recommends reuse first — list on ChemSurplus to recover value and stay compliant.
landingPages.h1: Obsolete chemicals? Reuse before you pay to dispose.
landingPages.intro: Regulators including the US EPA recommend finding a legitimate reuse before disposal — chemicals that are reclaimed or reused are generally not classed as hazardous waste. Listing obsolete, outdated or off-spec stock on ChemSurplus is the most efficient way to find that reuse, cut disposal costs and recover value.

faqs.q: Are reused chemicals still considered waste?
faqs.a: Generally no — if someone can legitimately reclaim or use them, the chemicals are not a waste under hazardous-waste rules. Documentation (SDS/COA) supports the transfer.

faqs.q: What if my chemicals can't be reused?
faqs.a: If no reuse is possible they must go to a permitted hazardous-waste facility. ChemSurplus helps you exhaust the reuse option first.

landingPages.title: Off-Spec Chemicals For Sale — Buy Usable Lots at a Discount | ChemSurplus
landingPages.metaDescription: Buy off-spec and factory-seconds chemicals at a steep discount. Fully usable lots with SDS/COA, ideal for applications that don't require prime specification.
landingPages.h1: Off-spec chemicals for sale — prime performance, off-spec price.
landingPages.intro: Off-spec doesn't mean unusable. Many off-specification lots miss a single prime parameter yet perform perfectly in less demanding applications — at 30–70% below market. Every lot on ChemSurplus carries documentation so you know exactly what you're buying.

faqs.q: Is off-spec material safe to use?
faqs.a: It's the same chemistry, off a prime spec on one parameter. Review the COA and SDS against your application requirements before buying.

faqs.q: How much cheaper is off-spec?
faqs.a: Typically 30–70% below prime market price depending on the deviation, quantity and shelf life.

landingPages.h1: Short-dated chemicals — move them before the clock runs out.
landingPages.intro: Short-dated and near-expiry raw materials are a race against the calendar. ChemSurplus connects sellers who need to move them with buyers whose throughput can consume them well within shelf life — turning a looming write-off into a fast, documented deal.

faqs.a: Yes, provided you consume them within the stated best-by window. Each listing shows the shelf-life date.

faqs.q: Why are short-dated lots cheaper?
faqs.a: The shorter remaining shelf life narrows the buyer pool, so sellers price aggressively to move the lot in time.
